text:
mira: heads-up — saw some odd routing/telemetry for embeddings traffic hitting the new ingress-shim. mixed-dim batch got routed to small-shard but metrics tagged it as 1536d which blew up the shard. logs attached below. :grimacing:

sam: can you paste the request payload? we treat dim hints differently in the shim compared to splitter right now

mira: snippet ->
```json
{
  "model": "openembed-v2",
  "inputs": [[...1536-vector...], [...512-vector...]],
  "client_hint": {"preferred_dim": 1536}
}
```

devon: ack. bug looks like "ingress-shim" copies `client_hint.preferred_dim` into request meta and we downstream-index routing by that tag instead of actual payload dims. splitter uses real shape detection so it split correctly, but router saw the tag and sent to 1536-only pool.

karan: oh nice catch. consequence = wrong shard capacity estimation + telemetry showing inflated 1536 qps. affects quota accounting and per-route cost calc too.

mira: impact: two incidents last night (short tail) where small-shard CPU spiked and fallback kicked in. customers with mixed arrays got 413/fastfail.

sam: proposed fix: change shim to strip `client_hint.preferred_dim` before routing or amend router to consult `payload_shapes` deterministic first. which is cheaper?

devon: router change safer long-term (single source of truth) but bigger surface area. shim strip is quick mitigation.

karan: telemetry needs a new dimension: `routing_basis` = ["hint","shape_detected"]. that will let us know how often hints override reality. add to embed_route.{count,latency,cost} metrics.

console-ux: we'll want a console flag (toggle) to show routing_basis in the per-route dashboard. small UX: a checkbox under Embeddings -> Route details: "Show routing basis" which expands a bar chart. low priority but useful for customers debugging their hints.

sam: plan: 1) emergency shim-strip revert (hotfix) -> 2) router follow-up to make `payload_shapes` authoritative -> 3) emit `routing_basis` metric + console toggle -> 4) rollout with canary to 10% tenants then 50% -> 5) postmortem+changelog. anyone object?

mira: no objections. I'll open a PR for the shim strip now and include unit test that verifies tags removed.

devon: i'll spec the router change and put an RFC in eng-platform backlog. includes perf benchmark for shape detection cost; shouldn't add per-request overhead beyond current path.

karan: I'll wire the metric and create a Grafana panel prototype, post link when done. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: hotfix job queued -> job id d-2026-171456 -> will run in 5m and notify on finish.

sam: thumbs up. please also add an alert rule: if routing_basis=="hint" and small-shard CPU > 70% for 5m -> page oncall.

mira: noted. pinging @console-ux for the toggles ticket.

console-ux: got it, filing ticket with mockups and copy.

mira: thanks all. follow-up: I'll attach inc logs and tenant ids to the PR for traceability. :eyes:
